entries.title: Keep resource sales rates consistent in estimates
entries.description: Resource sales rates are easier to keep consistent across estimates. A sales rate card column can now be selected at client level and in the Companies tab, and the chosen column is used to fill the resource sales rate when an estimate is created. This brings sales-rate setup in line with purchase rates.

entries.title: Keep your project Gantt set up the way you like
entries.description: Create custom views in the project Gantt, just like in document lists. Save as many views as you need, each with its own filters and layout, and switch between them in a click. Your setup is no longer lost when you leave the screen.

entries.title: Let the AI Assistant turn client emails into Jobs
entries.description:
From client email to Job, without filling in a form

Skip the form and the retyping. Paste a client’s email into the AI Assistant and it sets up the Job for you: it finds the client and project, fills in the details and writes the brief from your Job Type template. You check it and approve.

entries.title: Show your brand in the browser tab
entries.description: Add your own icon to your tenant branding and every browser tab, including the login page, shows it instead of the Skills Workflow icon. The icon follows the same hostname rules as the rest of your branding, and the default icon stays when none is set.

entries.title: Pick up where you left off in grouped lists
entries.description: Come back to a grouped workspace grid and find it just as you left it. Open and closed groups and your scroll position are now kept when you leave the workspace or reload the page, for each custom view, so you no longer have to reopen groups and scroll back to your place.

entries.title: Filter resources by typology group
entries.description: Focus your planning on the roles you need. Filter resources in the Resources workspace now includes a Typology Group section, so you can pick a group and see only its resources and their planning. Combine it with the other filters to narrow the results further.
